sql:
SELECT s.Street AS Postal_Street, s.School AS School_Name
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) as avg_math
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    ORDER BY avg_math DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
